chapter: The Dallas nightclub and Jesse Stone's band
title: Lineup of the Blue Serenaders
summary: Hinton and Budd list the band's members: Tompkins, Keg, Durham, violinist Claude, Booker Pittman and John R. Davis.

bands.name: Jesse Stone and His Blue Serenaders

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: So he had this band, Jesse Stone and the Blue Serenaders.
Which was Coleman Hawkins first band.
Coleman Hawkins first worked in his band.
And you guys came through there later, huh.
We came through there later, of course. This was like 1928.
And then Ed Tompkins, and You, and Keg Johnson, your brother.

Yeah, and we had this little guy named Claud -- what was Claud's last name? That played a fiddle with a horn on it. He was like the Stuff Smith of his day. One of the great violin players that I don't think the world knows too much about.

Claude-- what was Claude's last name? Claude Smith? Claude-- oh, could this guy play the violin! And we featured the violin back in those days, also, and we had Booker Pittman. We had John R. Davis, the drummer. Most of these guys were the original guys from when I went to school with, because they were all proficient by this time. And --
